The '''Terr'skiar Pass''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] connecting the [[Terr'skiar system/Legends|Terr'skiar system]] with the [[Deysum system/Legends|Deysum system]]&mdash;the [[Capital/Legends|capitals]] of [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar]] and [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] respectively&mdash;via the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]]. The route was discovered around [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> when [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Arnoth Draenell]] found the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]]<ref name="GM">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Kit]]''</ref> while attempting to blaze a new trail through the southern edge of the [[Thornhedge Nebula/Legends|Thornhedge Nebula]].<ref name="Atlas" /> A [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] malfunction dumped Draenell and his expedition in the system, which they catalogued and noted as a excellent resupply stopover for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling the new Terr'skiar Pass. Around [[150 BBY/Legends|150 BBY]], settlers colonized one of the planets in the Bissillirus system, [[Draenell's Point]], hoping that the Terr'skiar Pass would become a major trade route. Their speculation never bore fruit, but [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] on the planet discovered that Draenell's Point was perfect for agricultural industries.<ref name="GM" />
